QuestInfo.name: Mystic Gate Researcher
QuestInfo.0: Professor Moon has something to say to you.
QuestInfo.1: Professor Moon says that he'll give you the qualifications to become a Mystic Field researcher if you help him stop the Mystic Field.
QuestInfo.2: Professor Moon thanked you for helping him stop the Mystic Field and gave you the Mystic Field Researcher medal.

0.0: You've done much to keep Maple World safe, just as I hope to one day do much to keep Maple World entertained, but the Mystic Energy lingers still. We must keep fighting. You for your thing and me for mine.
0.1: Eliminate Mystic bosses, use their Mystic Energy 100 times, and I will grant you the qualifications to become a Mystic Field Researcher. While you didn't actually do any research, I don't mind sharing the credit.

no.0: One must never give up on one's dreams...

1.0: Once I fully comprehend the nature of this Mystic Energy, we can put a stop to it once and for all. If only becoming a pop idol were as simple as understanding the true nature of the universe. Ah well.

default.0: Eliminate Mystic bosses, use their Mystic Energy 100 times, and I will grant you the qualifications to become a Mystic Field Researcher. While you didn't actually do any research, I don't mind sharing the credit.
